reason: Exor N.V. is a holding company that invests in various companies across sectors (Ferrari, Stellantis, CNH, Philips, bioMérieux, Clarivate, etc.). The 2024 Annual Report does not contain any total addressable market (TAM) disclosures from Exor itself. While subsidiary companies like Ferrari, Stellantis, CNH, and others may disclose their own TAMs in their respective filings, Exor as the parent holding company does not aggregate or disclose a consolidated TAM for its investment portfolio. The filing focuses on NAV, portfolio performance, and individual company operational metrics rather than market sizing.
